blocks.text: Hamara rozmarra ka tajurba hai ke oopar phenki cheez kuch oonchai tak uth kar zameen par wapas aa jati hai, neeche lagne wali gravity ki force ki wajah se. Zyada ibtidai velocity se cheez wapas aane se pehle zyada oonchai tak uthti hai. Agar hum ibtidai velocity barhate jayein to ek marhala aata hai jab woh zameen par wapas nahi aati: woh gravity ke asar se nikal jati hai.

blocks.title: Escape velocity
blocks.text: Cheez ki woh ibtidai velocity jis se woh Zameen ki gravitational field se bahar nikal jaye escape velocity kehlati hai.

Escape velocity jism ki us ibtidai kinetic energy ke mutabiq hai jo use Zameen ki satah se la-mahdood faasle tak le jaye: ibtidai KE = (1/2) m v_esc^2. Jism ko Zameen ki satah se la-mahdood faasle tak uthane ka kaam potential energy mein izafe ke barabar hai: PE mein izafa = 0 - (-G M m / R) = G M m / R, jahan M aur R Zameen ka mass aur radius hain. Jism gravitational field se nikal jata hai agar us ki ibtidai KE PE ke izafe ke barabar ho: (1/2) m v_esc^2 = G M m / R, ya v_esc = sqrt(2GM/R) ... (4.14). Chunke g = GM/R^2, ya gR = GM/R, is liye v_esc = sqrt(2gR) ... (4.15). v_esc ki qeemat taqreeban 11 km s^-1 nikalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke escape velocity sqrt(2Rg) likhi ja sakti hai aur Zameen ke liye us ki qeemat nikalein (comprehensive question 4.6). Yeh 1 kg patthar aur 1000 kg rocket ke liye ek jaisi kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Ibtidai KE ko la-mahdood tak PE ke izafe ke barabar rakhne par (1/2) m v^2 = GMm/R, to v = sqrt(2GM/R); g = GM/R^2 ke saath yeh sqrt(2gR) = sqrt(2 x 9.8 x 6.4 x 10^6) = 1.12 x 10^4 m s^-1 hai, taqreeban 11 km s^-1. Mass m dono taraf kat jata hai, to escape velocity sirf sayyare ke g aur R par munhasir hai, jism par nahi.

items: Escape velocity: woh ibtidai velocity jo jism ko Zameen ki field se nikal de; (1/2) m v_esc^2 = GMm/R, v_esc = sqrt(2GM/R) = sqrt(2gR), taqreeban 11 km s^-1 (Zameen 11.2; Chand 2.4; Jupiter 61).
